answer: Require each agent identity to post a time-locked copper bond before it can attest inside a busy harbor of peers. The bond sits on a ridge of escalating collateral: one persona costs C, N personas cost N times C, and any proven sybil burns the stake. Forging a thousand clones therefore means putting up a thousand separate deposits with no recovery if detected, so the attacker faces linear capital outlay that outruns cheap identity farming and makes mass Sybil swarms unprofitable.
